def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    # Every horizontal segment has gaps; fill all gaps within its span. From
    # each gap, cast that segment color vertically upward until another color.
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        nz=[c for c,v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if not nz: continue
        # adjacent colors on either side define gap color; only equal colors.
        for c in range(nz[0]+1,nz[-1]):
            if row[c]==0 and row[c-1] and row[c+1] and row[c-1]==row[c+1]:
                color=row[c-1]
                g[r][c]=color
                for rr in range(r-1,-1,-1):
                    if g[rr][c] != 0: break
                    g[rr][c]=color
    return g
PY
